controls.name: always-majority-language diagnostic
controls.role: Required degenerate control for any future LID score; it exposes class imbalance and is not a language classifier.

controls.name: per-clip label versus intra-utterance switch separation
controls.role: One label per clip and a switch boundary answer different questions; neither may be scored or described as the other.

controls.name: unknown or out-of-set language
controls.role: An unlisted language stays unknown; it is never silently mapped to the nearest known language or to a no-speech label.

controls.name: monolingual English ASR control (Whisper tiny.en)
controls.role: Adjacent English-only ASR/timing baseline; it is not multilingual, cannot identify a language and is not a code-switch control.

controls.name: identity / no-annotation stream
controls.role: Emitting no language label preserves audio and transcript; any language decision must justify itself against this baseline.

controls.name: per-language confusion and macro-average
controls.role: A pooled accuracy or WER hides a small-language or code-switch stratum; per-language FN/FP and macro-average are required and not run.

controls.name: switch-boundary collar and decision delay
controls.role: Any future switch metric must fix the annotation collar, decision lag and hysteresis; no switch annotation or scorer exists.

controls.name: nonfinite and adverse input
controls.role: NaN/Inf scores, duplicate JSON keys and missing pins are rejected with state unchanged and cannot count as a pass.
